basis: installed systemd255 manual; no online version substituted
interpretation: Delegate on user@ service delegates controllers to user manager, not directly to arbitrary terminal child
resource properties cause systemd controller activation along hierarchy, which can affect siblings
MemoryMax limits unit group, TasksMax limits tasks including threads, CPUQuota is a bandwidth limit and throttles rather than causing exit
service is manager-spawned, scope wraps caller-spawned processes; service preferred for clean ownership and runtime stop control
